'''SE4-T25''' was the designation of a courteous [[Service droid/Legends|servant droid]] who operated a [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] in the [[Radell Mining Corporation]]'s [[Radell Mining Corporate Headquarters|Corporate Headquarters]] building on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Elrood/Legends|Elrood]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
